about.title: About
about.description: Engineer who turns ambiguous requirements into working systems, judges where AI fits, and builds client consensus on the basis for technical decisions. At a global consulting firm, provided technical support for a major life insurer's company-wide operations transformation and helped a life insurance group's IT subsidiary bring RAG in-house. Also takes on independent AI engagements as a Forward Deployed Engineer, including an AI tutor PoC for an education company, designed and built single-handedly. Previously built data-analysis and AI PoCs at a European consulting firm (FY2024 Corporate Award for an internal AI chat), drove data-driven decisions as a data analyst at an advertising agency, and proposed solutions at an IT company. In a part-time master's program at JAIST (expected March 2027), the research project in progress compares performance and implementation cost across the Python-to-C++/CUDA spectrum for foundational operations in the LLM era, toward guidelines for choosing a language and runtime.
